market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $115 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI peaked at ~$110 in May 2026 then fell to $93-100 amid US-Iran de-escalation. Reaching $115 in remaining 25 days requires a +15-20% rebound and a major Hormuz re-escalation. Polymarket consensus also leans bearish (yes_price 0.335).
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether Iran negotiations collapse and Hormuz disruption resumes
